items.rationale: The price of SD-120 is 899 and the cost is 430, so the margin is 899 - 430 = 469 KES.
The margin of SL-075 is 499 - 220 = 279 KES. Divided by the price of 499 this is 0.5591, which is 55.9% to 1 decimal place.
The margin of SN-450 is 1999 - 1100 = 899 KES. Mark-up divides this by the cost of 1100, which gives 0.8173, or 81.7% to 1 decimal place.

Margin percentage is the margin divided by the selling price, which is D2/C2. D2/B2 divides by the cost and gives the mark-up. B2/C2 gives the cost as a share of the price, and C2/D2 is the price divided by the margin, which is not a useful measure.
